messages:
Jules: Heads-up: QuasarHealth renewal demo on Thu 11am PT. I drafted a 12-minute pre-demo checklist focused on onboarding reliability, warmup, and the fallback narrative. Posting here for quick edits.

Ravi: Nice. Can we add a lightweight repro for the 900ms p99 they've seen and a simple graph to show before/after warmup?

Tess: Short runbook proposal (paste into invite):
1) Align success metric (30s) - confirm uptime + answer-stability expectations.
2) Warm-up (3m) - fire 8 calls across top 2 prompt templates to prime KV cache and batch lanes.
3) Latency spot-check (2m) - run the quick probe and share p50/p95/p99.
4) Failover demo (3m) - toggle canary->fallback and show Console fallback banner.
5) Capture feedback & next steps (2.5m) - who owns followups, and flag any demo QA issues.

Ravi: Quick probe (1-liner):
```bash
# probe 20 samples, print latency summary
python tools/probe_latency.py --model open-vicuna-13b --samples 20 --tenant quasar
```
Outputs p50/p95/p99 and kv-cache-hit% so CS can call out impact.

Arman: Ops checklist for call:
- Keep Console open to "Per-Route Latency"
- Enable tenant-level verbose logs for 45m: kubectl label svc/telemetry tenant=quasar-verbose=true
- Preload cache: POST 8 requests using the exact prompts the AM will use

Jules: Customer-facing fallback blurb for the demo notes: "If we detect sustained latency beyond our threshold, we will switch to a faster model variant. This preserves availability but may slightly alter phrasing; we'll capture any regressions and follow up with suggested prompt adjustments and a prioritized remediation plan."

Tess: Add a tiny cost note: warmup adds ~250-800 tokens total depending on response length; mention to AMs so they can weigh demonstration fidelity vs token cost.

Ravi: Repro snippet for the 900ms p99 (run in support shell):
```bash
# simulate traffic shape: 60% short, 40% long
for i in {1..40}; do
  if (( i % 5 == 0 )); then
    curl -s -X POST $API -d '{"input":"long sample text...","model":"open-7b"}' &
  else
    curl -s -X POST $API -d '{"input":"short ping","model":"open-7b"}' &
  fi
done; wait
# inspect p99 from metrics service
curl -s $METRICS/api/summary?tenant=quasar | jq '.latency.p99'
```

ops-bot: [deploy] Quasar canary status: last deploy 2026-02-14T17:04:11Z. No active incidents.

Jules: Action owners: Ravi - attach probe outputs + repro steps to invite; Tess - add warmup prompt set and token estimate; Arman - prep the canary toggle demo in staging and set tenant logs. I'll update invite and paste the customer-facing blurb.

Tess: Uploaded warmup prompts: https://docs.redwood.example/d/quasar-warmup. Included 2 short & 2 long templates.

Ravi: Probe outputs attached to invite. p50=45ms, p95=210ms, p99=920ms before warmup; after running warmup script p99 drops to ~240ms.

Arman: Done - canary toggle rehearsed in staging, tenant logs label pre-applied. Ready for Thu.

Jules: Thanks team. I'll include a one-slide fallback Q&A for the customer and a quick follow-up template for any quality regressions. :thumbsup:
